info.title: EntKube API
info.description: The management plane's public API. Every route takes a scoped API token as a bearer credential; the scope each one needs is stated on the operation. Tokens are created per tenant under the tenant's API tokens tab, and every call is answered in that tenant's scope only.

apiToken.description: A scoped EntKube API token. ⚠️ The token carries the tenant — there is no tenant parameter on any route, and a token cannot reach another tenant's rows.
